scope: Read-only JWE3 camera/focus benchmark for user review before implementation

evidence: Line 14 Focus(local, zoom) directly overwrites FocusLocal and Zoom and immediately calls Apply().
Lines 24-27 implement WASD plus arrow-key pan relative to yaw and Q/E yaw rotation.
Line 28 implements mouse-wheel zoom and middle-button drag pan.
Lines 37-43 force orthographic projection with a fixed 55-degree pitch and place the camera from the focus point.
Line 84 FocusAgency snaps to an agency with zoom 100.
Line 85 FocusVehicle snaps to a vehicle with zoom 80.
Line 18 toggles a private following team and calls FocusVehicle once on enable.
Lines 19-22 stop following only through other panel focus buttons.
Line 30 calls FocusVehicle(following) every Update while following.

contradictionsAndDefects.finding: Every agency/vehicle focus teleports the camera center and zoom because Focus immediately overwrites both state values and calls Apply.
contradictionsAndDefects.userImpact: The focus action reads as a snap rather than a navigable camera transition.

contradictionsAndDefects.finding: During follow, Update calls FocusVehicle every frame with zoom 80. Mouse wheel, WASD, and middle-drag changes made later in the frame are overwritten on the next Update.
contradictionsAndDefects.userImpact: Zoom and pan appear locked or spring back while tracking a vehicle.

contradictionsAndDefects.finding: Follow is private view state. It stops only when the same Vehicle Tracking button is toggled or another dispatch-panel location button clears it. Escape and direct navigation do not clear it.
contradictionsAndDefects.userImpact: Users cannot predictably leave tracking from the world view.

contradictionsAndDefects.finding: Current code forces an orthographic camera. Official published footage shows perspective depth in both cinematic and in-game UI views.
contradictionsAndDefects.limit: The footage supports perspective as a visual reference but does not provide an exact FOV or prove one universal gameplay camera mode.

contradictionsAndDefects.finding: Current code implements WASD and Q/E but omits the officially listed Page Up/Page Down zoom bindings. Mouse wheel zoom is present as a project-specific extension.

sourceBackedCore: WASD pans relative to current yaw.
Escape is available as contextual cancel only after modal/text-edit priority is respected.

projectSpecificMouseChoices.reason: Preserves the current working input and avoids the existing right-click world-order action.

projectSpecificMouseChoices.proposedBinding: hold right mouse and drag beyond the existing click threshold; a short right click remains the world-order action
projectSpecificMouseChoices.reason: Adds direct mouse orbit without removing the current right-click command, but needs interaction testing for accidental orders.

projectSpecificMouseChoices.proposedBinding: mouse wheel plus Page Up/Page Down
projectSpecificMouseChoices.reason: Keeps the existing wheel behavior while adding the verified official keyboard pair.

focus.proposal: Move the focus center with a 0.45-second ease-out transition. Preserve the user's current yaw, pitch, and zoom by default. A named preset may supply a target zoom only on the initial focus action, never every frame.
focus.acceptanceExample: Selecting an agency visibly travels to it; wheel zoom during or after arrival remains at the user's chosen value.

follow.proposal: Follow owns only the moving focus center. Zoom, yaw, and pitch remain user-owned. Smooth the center toward the vehicle without calling the one-shot Focus preset each frame.
follow.acceptanceExample: While a vehicle moves, wheel/Page Up/Page Down changes distance and Q/E or mouse orbit changes angle without breaking follow or snapping back.

proposal: Escape stops follow when no modal or text edit has higher priority.
WASD or middle-drag pan stops follow because it expresses intent to leave the target.
Clicking the active Vehicle Tracking button stops follow.
Focusing another agency, vehicle, incident, building, or floor stops/replaces follow.
Zoom and orbit do not stop follow.
followStop.acceptanceExample: After Escape or manual pan, the camera stays where the user leaves it and no longer re-centers on the vehicle.

projectionGate.proposal: Adopt perspective presentation as the JWE3-aligned direction; begin review with a 45-degree vertical FOV candidate and retain existing pitch/yaw as a tuning baseline.
projectionGate.jwe3Status: perspective appearance observed; numeric FOV and angle unverified
projectionGate.approvalQuestion: Approve perspective conversion now, or approve the snap/follow/input fix first while keeping orthographic projection for a separate visual review?

approvalQuestions: Approve the proposed mouse split: middle-drag pan, right-drag orbit, short right-click world order?
Approve manual pan and Escape as follow-stop actions while zoom/orbit continue following?
Approve 0.45-second focus ease-out and 0.18-second follow half-life as initial tuning values?
Approve perspective conversion in the same implementation increment, or defer it to a separately reviewed visual increment?

acceptanceRubricAfterApproval: Verified inputs: WASD pan, Q/E rotate, Page Up/Page Down zoom, mouse wheel zoom, middle-drag pan, approved mouse orbit mapping.
One-shot agency/vehicle focus does not teleport and does not repeatedly overwrite zoom.
Vehicle follow keeps the target centered while allowing continuous zoom and orbit.
Escape and manual pan stop follow under the approved input-context priority.
No right-click order is emitted by an orbit drag beyond the threshold.
Unity runtime observation is required; compilation alone is not acceptance.

rootVisualReview.finding: Root inspectedactualpublishedin-gameUI frames;depth/perspectiveappearance supported. Mousemapping/FOV/timing/followrules notproven.
